scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: Well, I'm a sales rep myself.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Normally, I'd only send out messages during holidays, or maybe just through Line groups.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Doing that every month is just way too exhausting and takes up way too much time.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: But if we could use these tools, like maybe with a one-click send feature, then we could potentially send these messages every month, or even every week. The impact of sending 3 times a year versus 12 or even 24 times on a customer's awareness and memory is completely different. So I think this tool is really useful.
